recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片出現大片、緊密黏在一起的深染小細胞團塊（cohesive clusters），跟周圍零散分布的造血細胞截然不同，提示非造血來源的轉移性腫瘤；甲狀腺髓質癌的確認需靠 calcitonin 等免疫染色。
features: Large cohesive sheets and clusters of tightly packed cells forming a dense, three-dimensional aggregate
Tumor cells small to intermediate with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm at this magnification
Clusters wrap around fat spaces within aspirated particles
Sharp contrast with the dispersed, non-cohesive hematopoietic cells in the background
Cytologic detail (chromatin, nucleoli, granules) not assessable at this low power
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows large cohesive clusters and sheets of densely packed, hyperchromatic cells, partly surrounding fat spaces, set against a blood-rich background with scattered dispersed hematopoietic cells. The cohesive growth pattern indicates a non-hematopoietic (epithelial/neuroendocrine) process. Fine cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and definitive classification requires the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry (e.g. keratin, synaptophysin/chromogranin, calcitonin, CEA, TTF-1). Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, in keeping with the reported metastatic medullary thyroid carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma or neuroblastoma
ddx.vs: These also form cohesive small-cell clusters with molding; separation from medullary thyroid carcinoma requires calcitonin/CEA (MTC) versus clinical context and markers such as PHOX2B for neuroblastoma.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia or lymphoma with clumped particles
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic blasts are dispersed and discohesive, whereas true tumor clusters remain tightly cohesive at the smear edges.
A normal particle contains a heterogeneous mix of maturing myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic cells rather than a monotonous cohesive population.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, and are loosely rather than densely aggregated.
